verdict.rationale: Otter ships automations such as auto-joining meetings, CRM sync, and pushing action items to Jira, Asana, and Zendesk, so this story fairly applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, change review, or rollback of those automations. Account-level audit trails and activity logs are an adjacent compliance feature, not automation version control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
